# Principles

Rules that hold for every site. Each site keeps its own choices in its taste doc: see `sites.md`.

## Content

What a page says and shows.

| ID and scope | Rule | Why | Fix | Check | Seen in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `least-text`<br>all | Show the least text that works. Give each card one picture, one short sentence and one action. | Shaun called the hub Open source section busy and messy. A wall of text in a card is not acceptable. | Delete fact lists. Let a picture or a demo carry the detail. Keep the summary to one sentence. | hub: `tools/checks/fit.mjs`<br>hub: `tools/checks/fit.json` | hub #15 |
| `picture-first`<br>public-site | Lead each project card with its own picture or looping clip. Put one line of text below it. | Text-first cards read as a wall of words. Shaun asked for a visual that moves on each project. | Put the screenshot, clip or drawing first. On a phone, hide the browser bar of the preview. | Manual walk | hub #15 |
| `proof-over-words`<br>all | Prefer a small interactive proof to a paragraph of explanation. | A paragraph on net benefit asks the reader to trust it. A slider lets the reader see it. | Build the simplest control that shows the effect. The dcurves threshold slider is the model. | hub: `tests/decision-curve.test.mjs` | hub #14 |
| `clips-not-embeds`<br>all | Show a demo as a short silent looping clip. Do not embed a video player. | Shaun finds embedded YouTube players tacky. | Record MP4 and WebM clips from the live demo. Play a clip only while it is on screen. | hub: `tests/clips.test.mjs` | hub #13 |
| `label-illustrations`<br>all | Label every drawing that uses invented numbers: Illustration only. Not real data. | A sample curve can pass as a real result. | Generate the drawing from declared sample values. Put the label in the caption. | hub: `tests/figure.test.mjs` | hub #14 |

## Layout

How a page fits a phone.

| ID and scope | Rule | Why | Fix | Check | Seen in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phone-first`<br>all | Judge every page at 390 px wide, in dark mode, before any wider width. | Shaun judges the sites on his phone. He called the first hub redesign terrible. | Walk 360, 390, 430, 820 and 1440 px, in both themes. Start at 390. | Manual walk | - |
| `centre-and-balance`<br>all | On a phone, center headings, chips and short copy. Keep the left and right margins equal. | Content sat off-center on the hub and on shaunporwal.com. | Use one gutter token. Left-align a list or a long text inside a centered block. | hub: `tools/checks/layout.mjs`<br>hub: `tests/layout.test.mjs` | hub #17, shaunporwal #7 |
| `buttons-share-width`<br>all | Buttons in one row share one width, or stack at full width. Give each card one primary button. | Buttons in ragged rows looked broken. | Set a minimum action width token. Let the row stack when it is too narrow. | Manual walk | - |
| `headings-two-lines`<br>public-site | A heading takes two lines or fewer at 360, 390, 820 and 1440 px. | A heading that wraps to many lines looks broken on a phone. | Shorten the heading. Use the fluid title tokens. | hub: `tools/checks/layout.mjs` | hub #17 |
| `no-sideways-scroll`<br>all | No page scrolls sideways at any width. | Sideways scroll means something overflows its frame. | Find the wide element. Wrap it, shrink it or clip it on purpose. | hub: `tools/checks/layout.mjs` | hub #17, hub #10 |
| `card-fits-screen`<br>public-site | A project card fits the screen below the sticky header on an iPhone 15 Pro. | Shaun said the cards were too tall. | Cut text. Put the picture first. Measure with the fit check. | hub: `tools/checks/fit.mjs`<br>hub: `tools/checks/fit.json` | hub #15, hub #5, hub #8 |
| `tap-targets`<br>all | Make each tap target at least 44 px wide and 44 px high. | Small targets cause missed taps. | Pad the target, not the glyph. Use the touch token. | Manual walk | shaunporwal #7 |
| `menu-cannot-stretch`<br>public-site | Build the phone menu so no browser can stretch its rows. Do not use a grid in a tall panel. | Some WebKit browsers stretch grid rows. No WebKit browser is installed here to test. | Use a flex or block layout. Test the CSS rule. | cheminventory: `tests/menu.test.ts`<br>shaunporwal: `tests/test_menu_css.py` | cheminventory #11 |
| `menu-covers-page`<br>public-site | An open phone menu covers the page, locks scroll and makes the page inert. | Shaun called the shaunporwal.com burger menu extremely unnatural. | Use an opaque full panel. Move focus into it. Close it on Escape and at the wide breakpoint. | cheminventory: `tests/menu.test.ts` | cheminventory #11, shaunporwal #7 |
| `judge-by-tiles`<br>all | Judge a page from tall tile screenshots, not from one full-page image. | A full-page image is too small to show a flaw. | Scroll first so lazy images load. Shoot 900 px tiles at 360, 390 and 430 px, in both themes. | Manual walk | - |

## Look

Color, type and the AI tells.

| ID and scope | Rule | Why | Fix | Check | Seen in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `no-ai-tells`<br>all | Avoid the AI tells: gradient blobs, glow text, three-color icon chips, three-part slogans and filler words. | Shaun calls such pages AI generated. | Use one accent. Write plain nouns and verbs. Cut filler. | Manual walk | - |
| `one-accent`<br>all | Use one accent color. | One accent tells the reader where to look. | Mark links, focus and the one primary action with it. A project color never colors a button. | Manual walk | - |
| `tokens-only`<br>all | Take every color, size and timing from a token file. A raw value in CSS fails a test. | One source means one change. | Add a token before you write a literal. | hub: `tests/css.test.mjs`<br>shaunporwal: `tests/test_css_tokens.py`<br>bench-bridge: `design/check.ts` | - |
| `contrast-both-themes`<br>all | Text pairs meet WCAG AA in the light theme and in the dark theme. | A pair can pass in one theme and fail in the other. | Give every color a dark value. List each pair with its least ratio. Let a test check the list. | hub: `tests/contrast.test.mjs`<br>shaunporwal: `tests/test_theme_contrast.py`<br>cheminventory: `tests/palette.test.ts`<br>bench-bridge: `design/contrast.json` | - |
| `no-third-party-packs`<br>all | Do not install third-party design skill packs. Do not copy third-party component code into a public repository. | The Taste Skill pack bans glows and shadows. That conflicts with the alive kit. | Read a pack for ideas. Turn an idea into a measured check of your own. | Manual walk | - |

## Process

How to prove the work.

| ID and scope | Rule | Why | Fix | Check | Seen in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `measure-the-complaint`<br>all | Turn each taste complaint into a measured check. | Words like busy or off-center are not repeatable. | Add the check to the site's check command. Show that it fails when you tighten the limit. | hub: `tools/checks/layout.mjs`<br>hub: `tests/layout.test.mjs` | hub #17 |
| `walk-live-site`<br>public-site | Walk the live site at phone width after each merge. | Shaun judges the sites on production, not on a preview. | Check for overflow at four widths in both themes. Fetch the discovery files. | Manual walk | - |
| `walk-tailnet-link`<br>all | Run browser walks at the tailnet link, not only at localhost. | A browser treats localhost as secure. That hides failures such as a missing crypto.randomUUID. | Use the link that npm run dev prints. | Manual walk | - |
| `propose-repeat-fixes`<br>all | When the same fix applies to another page, propose it. Build it after approval. | A fix built unasked on another page is a change of scope. | Name the page and the fix in one line. Wait for a yes. | Manual walk | - |
| `taste-in-situ`<br>all | Keep each site's own taste in its design doc. Keep the shared fundamentals in this skill. | Two copies of one rule drift apart. | Add a new fundamental to this skill and to the site doc in one change. Run the sites check. | Manual walk | - |
